title: merge/test_merge.py made real GitHub lock calls despite a gh stub; find the path the stub misses
why: Real incident, rebuild lane #2826/#2892, coordinator 12:31 CST Nov 13: two full runs of merge/test_merge.py by the lane's test-author made real lock calls on shivinate7/claude-settings (rate-limit errors); a killed run left orphan pid 17592 (ppid 1).
note: Todo, debt candidate (real incident). Likely cause (unconfirmed): the merge tool reaches GitHub by a path that does not use `gh` (MCP or REST), so the PATH stub misses it. Test name unknown (full file, not isolated). Fix shape: a test must fail closed when it would reach the network. The classifier refused the lane's `kill 17592` twice; the coordinator asks the owner to approve it. Runner 10 watches batch 137 for stray lock refs or comments from that run. Check the stray-lock read before closing.
